lead: Each group below is ONE Codex conversation: paste its prompts one after another, each after the previous one finishes. The button Copy whole conversation copies the group's prompts in order, with a separator line between them; Copy prompt copies a single one.

Codex works in the main checkout (G:\DEV\Terepasztal\terepasztal), which has one branch checked out at a time. So run ONE group at a time there. Two groups can run at the same time only if Codex gives each its own git worktree. Every group is on its own branch, except that the Later prompt C33b belongs to the Rotations conversation (same branch, art/535-rotations).
Turned views are painted over Core's 3D scaffolds (branch claude/art-scaffolds-review-2, head fc07d589); each prompt says how to read them. Accepted pictures are not painted again.

groups.title: Rotations over scaffolds
groups.run: Paste in this order: the gameplay blockers first (Big Station, Big Farm, town hall, warehouse, the 1 x 1 buildings), then the larger plants, then the house, then the hydro plant r0 last (it stops after r0). The branch already holds twelve jobs from 19 October: each prompt rebases before it pushes.
groups.same: Shares its branch with the Later prompt C33b, which goes into this same conversation. A second conversation on art/535-rotations needs its own worktree.

groups.title: Buildings-v2 lane
groups.run: Paste in this order: the narrow depot r0 (stage 1, it stops after r0), the farm halt, the quarry, the coaling stage. The farm and quarry prompts start with a Step 0 that restores their pictures from the backup snapshot.
groups.same: Only this group uses art/325-buildings-v2. It touches assets/source/buildings-v2/ only.
groups.status: Ready. The narrow depot's stage 2 waits for Core's scaffold.

groups.title: Windmill
groups.run: Paste C17c first, then C17d after C17c has committed (C17d needs the hub point C17c records).
